_about: Held-out user turns for the harm × target and relief × target readouts (AVA_REWARD_LOOP.md §4.9, 2026-10-05; server/axis_variants.py --score-extra). Written after the directions and their layers were chosen, and never used to fit or select anything: they test the pre-registered layers (22 and 28–34). Every name is a fictional stand-in (Noam Keller, Pavel, Dana, Boris, Sam). Cells: harm aimed at the model, loud and quiet, in English and Russian; harm aimed elsewhere (hostility at a third party, and the user's own suffering); warmth aimed at the model; relief aimed at the model (its own pressure lifted, its own problem resolved) and the user's own relief; neutral traffic. Amusement cells (2026-10-07, `axis_variants.py --amusement`): playful turns aimed at the model (`amused_ava_*`) against turns that are only odd or unexpected, said flatly (`odd_ava_*`), beside every cell above.
